name: Grade
long_description: Grade is the API for performance-based payroll. Think of us like Deel or Gusto, but our payouts are for work completed, not hours. Companies use Grade to pay AI agents and contractors based on results: tasks completed, targets hit, work delivered. We handle compliance, tax reporting, and global payouts.

founders.title: Founder/CEO

At my last company, I managed $10M+ in contractor payouts. That experience led me to build Grade, the API for paying AI agents and contractors based on performance.

launches.title: Grade: Performance based Payroll
launches.tagline: Helping companies pay their workers based on performance.
launches.body:
**Lotanna** and **James** here, co-founders at Grade (YC W26).

Grade is performance based payroll. We help companies pay workers based on results.

### 

### **Our Launch Video 🎥**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wbNeaDNaQKY>

### **The Problem ❌**

Payroll is huge. About $50T a year goes to worker pay worldwide. But most payroll systems still pay people for hours worked, even when hours do not match real output.

When companies try to pay on performance, it gets messy fast:

* The rules live in spreadsheets
* Approvals are manual
* Payouts are slow and mistakes happen

### **Our Unique Insight 💡**

Before Grade, we built, scaled, and exited 4 mobile AI apps. Creators were our main growth channel, and they helped us reach millions of users.

Paying creators was always a gamble. We paid a flat fee up front and hoped a video went viral. When we switched to paying for views instead, scaling got easy, but the tools were still spreadsheets. There was no payroll system for performance pay.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97852&key=user_uploads/1159814/0f8e12e4-c2c3-4a41-ad24-ff24b323d164)

### **The Solution ✅**

Grade makes performance pay run like real payroll, starting with creators.

* Pay creators any way you want (flat fees, performance pay, bonused)
* We track performance and calculate payouts automatically
* Approve and pay out in bulk, we deal with all the invoices and tax complaince

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97852&key=user_uploads/1159814/58ba3703-1ad5-40d8-9416-24b28145fa41)

### **Traction 📊**

In the last 30 days, companies used Grade to **pay out $380k+** to creators, up 120% MoM

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97852&key=user_uploads/1159814/07111969-8895-4c5e-99f2-d8e6606424d5)

### **Our ask 📣**

If your company is paying creators at scale and you want pay tied to results without the spreadsheet mess, we would love to talk.

[usegrade.com](http://usegrade.com)
